card.name: Final Showdown Frieza
card.skill:
[Critical]
[Double Strike]
[Auto][Once per turn] When your opponent declares to play a Battle Card or activates a skill that puts Battle Cards into play, if your Leader Card is a red ≪Frieza's Army≫ card, you may choose 1 card from your life and place it in your Drop Area. If you do, the Battle Card is played with its skills negated for the duration of the turn. This skill can be activated at Counter Timing.

qa.q: Can this card’s Auto skill negate the skills of a Battle Card with [Deflect]?
qa.a: Yes, it can. If it does, the Battle Card is played with its skills negated for the duration of the turn.

qa.q: Your opponent announces that they’re playing the first Battle Card of the turn, and you don’t use this card’s Auto skill to place a card from your life into your Drop Area to negate the skills of your opponent’s Battle Card. If your opponent declares they will play another Battle Card later in the same turn, will this card’s Auto skill resolve?
qa.a: No. It will neither activate nor resolve.
